access_evidence: probe crossref_works_doi: HTTP 200 with created/issued/published-print/published-online timestamps, author list, funder awards and per-record licence array; probe crossref_absent_doi: HTTP 404 with a 19-byte 'Resource not found.' body. 60 anchor lookups: 59 found, 1 absent, 0 errors.
historical_depth: Full back file. `created` is the DOI registration timestamp, so it is a genuine historical record; `deposited`/`indexed` are mutable.
licence_note: Crossref makes metadata openly available for reuse and asks only for a polite contact, but attaches no single blanket content licence to the metadata; the per-record `license[]` array is preserved because that is where the rights actually are. Recorded as open_no_explicit_licence rather than assumed open.
name: Crossref REST API
notes: Crossref exposes NO pmid/pmcid. Any workflow that needs the DOI<->PMID edge must get it from PubMed, Europe PMC or Semantic Scholar.
rate_policy: Polite pool via a contact User-Agent; no published hard limit.
what_is_new: The only source here where the creation timestamp is a registry event (DOI registration) rather than an index event. Holds 59/60 anchors and contributes 13 of 60 anchors with funder-award metadata, which is one of the two usable grant-declaration surfaces.
